showcase.zh: 一个元件现在给出所有对得上的结果，按顺序排成一串；后面的元件对每一种都做一遍，走不通的那几种自己消失：这就是回溯，光看说明想不到后面的元件会替前面的元件收拾残局
showcase.en: a part now gives every result that fits, in order; each later part works on each of them, and those that lead nowhere drop out: this is backtracking, and from the description alone one does not guess that later parts clear up after earlier ones

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.en: There is no need to defer.

t.zh: 第二组测试里，两个目标都有不止一个人对得上，先证哪一个都会先拿错人，调整次序也无济于事。
t.en: In the second test more than one person fits each goal; whichever goes first takes the wrong one first, and reordering the goals does not help.

t.zh: 从这一关起，元件给出所有对得上的结果，按顺序排成一串：每对上一条已知，就是一种结果。后面的元件对每一种都做一遍，做不下去的自行消失，留下的第一种就是答案。元件上显示「第 1 种结果，共 n 种」。
t.en: From this level on a part gives every result that fits, one after another: each given that fits is a result. Each later part works on every one of them; those that cannot go on drop out, and the first left is the answer. A part shows “result 1 of n”.
